text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.orig_text:
やったねっ！　
どんなもんだいっ！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Sheesh. That took a bit of effort and then some.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まったく、
骨が折れる相手だったな……

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
That applies to you, too.
I wouldn't expect any less.
text_block_list.orig_text:
キミもよく頑張ったね。
さすがの活躍だったよ。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとね、
騎士くん！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
We were able to win thanks to you!
Thank you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士クンのおかげで
わたしたち、
ちゃんと勝てたよ。
ありがとう！
